Frequently Asked Questions

Is the CLI always free?

Yes. Recording and replaying on your local machine is open-source and will always be free. We only charge when you move to team collaboration and production reliability features.

How does Team Sync work?

Team Sync securely uploads your local traces to the agrepl Cloud, allowing you to generate a shareable ID. Your teammates can then use `agrepl pull ` to reproduce the exact state on their own machine.
